title: VISUALPRM400K: An Effective Dataset for Multimodal Process Reward Modeling
paper_type_zh: 过程/轨迹监督数据与过程奖励研究
best_for_zh: 构建、审计或复用步骤级推理反馈数据的研究者。
one_line: VISUALPRM400K: An Effective Dataset for Multimodal Process Reward Modeling exposes process or trace supervision data.
发布约 40 万条 VisualPRM400K 多模态过程监督数据，并基于它训练 VisualPRM、构建 VisualProcessBench 评测步骤纠错。
why: It makes intermediate reasoning feedback auditable before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Process/trace supervision data release or data-construction method.

title: Problem
问题
html: Multimodal PRMs are limited by the lack of large-scale, step-level visual reasoning supervision. VisualPRM400K asks how to build a 400K-scale dataset of multimodal process annotations that can support robust verifier training.
多模态过程奖励模型受限于缺少大规模、步骤级的视觉推理监督。VisualPRM400K 研究如何构建 40 万规模的多模态过程标注数据集，以支持稳健的验证器训练。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: VisualPRM400K releases 400,000 multimodal process-supervision examples for step-reward training in visual reasoning, covering image conditions, candidate derivations, labels, and answer outcomes. It localises sparse outcome feedback to reasoning steps for training and diagnosis.
核心贡献是：发布 VisualPRM400K：40 万条多模态过程监督数据，为视觉推理中的步骤奖励训练提供规模化语料。 数据对象可概括为：数据覆盖图像条件、候选推导、步骤标签和答案结果，并通过构造与筛选控制视觉误读、算术错误和逻辑跳步等噪声。 它把“最终答案是否正确”的稀疏反馈改写为可定位到推理过程的监督契约，因而既能服务训练，也能暴露模型在何一步开始偏离。

title: Method
方法
html: It trains or evaluates VLM-PRMs and compares data scale, visual-evidence binding, and process-reward gains. It produces or uses step labels, preferences, or rewards from problems, traces, and intermediate states; reproduction must check the generator, verifier, sampling budget, and filtering rules.
方法上，适合训练或评测 VLM-PRM，并可用于比较数据规模、视觉证据绑定和过程奖励的增益。 训练或使用阶段，适合训练或评测 VLM-PRM，并可用于比较数据规模、视觉证据绑定和过程奖励的增益。 输入通常包括题目、已有轨迹与中间状态；输出是步骤标签、比较偏好或连续奖励。应分别核验生成器、终局验证器、采样预算与过滤规则，因为它们共同决定标签含义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Evidence should be checked against the primary paper for tasks, sample counts, step segmentation, label provenance, metrics, and outcome-supervision baselines. Official code and downloadable data are recorded only when the primary source identifies them; a paper URL is not itself an artifact link.
证据应回到主论文逐项核查：任务集、样本量、步骤切分、标签来源、评测指标和与结果监督的对照。主论文页面未标注独立官方实现；此处明确保留为未发布，不能以第三方复刻替代。主论文页面未标注独立官方下载数据；卡片不把论文链接误记为数据链接。 若复现实验，应固定论文版本、模型版本、随机种子和验证环境，并记录失败样本而非只复述汇总分数。

title: Novelty
新意
html: This work changes the unit or acquisition path of process evidence relative to whole-chain labels. VisualPRM400K releases 400,000 multimodal process-supervision examples for step-reward training in visual reasoning, covering image conditions, candidate derivations, labels, and answer outcomes.
相对把整条 CoT 只标为对或错的做法，该工作改变的是过程数据的采集或使用单位。发布 VisualPRM400K：40 万条多模态过程监督数据，为视觉推理中的步骤奖励训练提供规模化语料。 这也是它进入 Process / Trace Supervision Data 的原因；但“使用过程奖励”本身并非新意，真正应复用的是其数据契约、质量控制与评测边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper stresses the dataset, but the public repository must follow the authors? final release; large synthetic or semi-automatic labels still require sampled human audit. It remains an auxiliary training or search signal and requires executable checks, human review, and sample audits before transfer.
局限需要与贡献一并阅读：论文版本强调数据集但公开仓库需以作者最终 release 为准；大规模合成/半自动标签仍应抽样人工审计。 过程分数是训练或搜索的辅助信号，不能替代可执行验证、人工审核或领域专家判断。跨领域使用前，至少应抽样检查标签是否仍对应目标任务中的真实错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For data researchers, the paper is a concrete recipe to compare: state granularity, candidate source, label or preference construction, negative examples, and acceptance criteria. For model builders it can support PRM training, best-of-N reranking, tree search, and trace filtering. For evaluators, first-error localization and calibration matter more than answer accuracy alone.
对数据研究者，最直接的价值是把该工作当成一份可比较的数据配方：明确状态粒度、候选来源、标签或偏好产生机制、负例构造和验收指标。对模型研究者，它可用于 PRM 训练、best-of-N 重排、树搜索和轨迹过滤；对评测者，则应优先报告首错定位与校准而非只报最终正确率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A productive reading order is to inspect availability and provenance first, then trace context and label evidence, and only then study the reported gain. Compare the design with PRM800K, rollout-derived labels, and preference-tree supervision. Finally, inspect high-scoring wrong traces to determine whether the verifier learned reasoning quality or superficial style, length, and answer leakage.
阅读时建议先检查数据对象是否可获得、样本是否保留原始上下文、标签是否可追溯到验证证据，再看模型提升。其次比较它与 PRM800K、自动 rollout 标签和偏好树方法的差异。最后手工抽取若干高分错误轨迹，判断奖励模型到底识别了推理质量，还是偏好了格式、长度或答案泄漏。
